rv.q: Prayer Circle is an entertaining and thought-provoking addition to Redtwist Theatre’s “State of Violence” season.
PRAYER CIRCLE is being given a very respectable production at Redtwist, as it opens the company's awe-inspiring, 22nd season.
The strength of this script is the characters—who are clearly defined and familiar types—and the performances, directed by Dusty Brown , are uniformly outstanding.
I liked Prayer Circle , but the dialogue, character development, and staging could use improvement.
Prayer Circle struggles on all three fronts.
This is a production that will probably mean different things to different people.

cn.t: Gernand's dark comedy about a prayer group with deadly powers earns laughs with sharp characters and strong performances, though critics are divided on whether its provocative premise fully delivers on its moral complexities.
